processes.name: Scheduling web app

processes.name: Scheduling service
processes.description: The service that reads and writes rotas and produces a weekly payroll export.

processes.name: Payroll system
processes.description: A payroll system run by another team that collects the payroll export from the file share.
processes.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.

trust_boundaries.name: Internal network
trust_boundaries.description: The internal network containing the scheduling service, rota database and file share.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The scheduling service, the rota database and the file share are on the internal network.

trust_boundaries.name: Own phone
trust_boundaries.description: The zone containing colleagues' own phones used to reach the scheduling web app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Colleagues reach the app from their own phones.
trust_boundaries.notes: Store managers are assigned to this user-device boundary because their access device is not otherwise specified.

assumptions.assumption: The rota database is confidential because it holds colleague names, contact details and stated availability.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database holds colleague names, contact details and stated availability.

assumptions.assumption: The file share is confidential because it holds a payroll export.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the scheduling service writes a payroll export onto the file share.

assumptions.assumption: The store manager is in the own-phone boundary because the source provides no separate access-device or user boundary for store managers.
assumptions.basis: The source states that colleagues use their own phones but does not specify how store managers reach the app; the available user-device boundary is own phone.
